Hi Alan / Samantha,

Thanks for agreeing to start the vendor setup with us. To get Brightbeam created in our vendor master and enable POs/invoicing, could you confirm the following items and attach any docs you have?

- Legal entity name as it should appear on invoices (exactly, matching W-9 / local tax doc)

- Preferred remittance method (ACH preferred; wires occasionally) and remit contact email

Next steps on our side after we receive the docs: validate legal name/tax ID, map a short vendor code, and enable PO routing in ERP. Expect a follow-up from AP/Procurement within 24–48 hours for final confirmation.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
